text:
If, as the blue bellflowers
on your balcony sway,
you think the murmuring wind
passes with a sigh,
know that, hidden among the green leaves,
it is I who sigh.

If, when a vague sound echoes
behind you,
you think a distant voice
has called your name,
know that, among the shadows around you,
it is I who call.

If in the dead of night
your heart stirs with fear
when you feel a burning breath
upon your lips,
know that, though invisible, beside you
it is I who breathe.

translation.title: Rhyme XVI: If, as the Blue Bellflowers Sway
